models._help: Each role is a chain 'provider:model' - first is preferred, the rest are used automatically when a model hits a limit, isn't available, or its provider is down. Providers: groq (GROQ_API_KEY), openrouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Only free OpenRouter models (':free' or 'openrouter/free') are used unless allow_paid_openrouter_models is true. For testing you can override a chain in .env, e.g. HQ_MODEL_AGENT=openrouter:openrouter/free,groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b

_rate_limits_help: Tokens-per-minute limit per model, read from Groq's x-ratelimit headers for this account (Groq free tier: 8,000/min, 1,000 requests/day; gpt-oss also 200,000 tokens/day). OpenRouter free models: ~20 requests/min and 50/day on a key without credits. The app waits for per-minute limits and falls back along the chain for daily limits or outages.
_price_sheets_help: Add one entry per brand. type 'excel' = local .xlsx/.xlsm (re-read automatically when the file is saved). type 'google_sheets' = live Google Sheet: {"type": "google_sheets", "sheet_id": "<id from the URL>", "refresh_seconds": 300, "display_name": "..."} shared as 'anyone with the link can view'.

chat._help: max_message_chars: longest message a user can send. recent_exchanges_verbatim: how many recent user/assistant exchanges the agent sees word-for-word; older ones are folded into a running summary (nothing is lost: facts and quotes also live in long-term memory).
